description: This PHP class 'CandidateAttachmentAPI' provides REST API endpoints for managing candidate attachments within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM HRM system, including creating, retrieving, and updating candidate attachments.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class handling CRUD operations for candidate attachments in the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve all candidate attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new candidate attachment, saving it via the recruitment attachment service.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates candidate ID with a CandidateAttachment entity and sets base64 attachment data.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Extracts base64 attachment data from the request and assigns file properties to the CandidateAttachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to delete candidate attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a candidate's attachment based on candidate ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single candidate attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or deletes a candidate attachment based on the currentAttachment parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Transforms a CandidateAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO.
